b1-rakosikorszak-01.title: Communicative Challenge: The End of Free Elections
b1-rakosikorszak-01.scenario: You are preparing for your citizenship interview. The examiner asks which party won the free election of 1945 and how the communists got rid of the other parties.
b1-rakosikorszak-01.prompt: Tell the examiner which party won in 1945 and what the communists did to the opposition parties.
cues: Say which party won the free election of 1945
Say how the communists removed the opposition parties
b1-rakosikorszak-01.target: 1945-ben a Független Kisgazdapárt nyerte a választást. A kommunisták szalámitaktikával számolták fel az ellenzéki pártokat.
b1-rakosikorszak-01.english: In 1945 the Independent Smallholders' Party won the election. The communists dismantled the opposition parties with salami tactics.
b1-rakosikorszak-01.canDo: I can explain how the communists removed the opposition parties one by one between 1945 and 1948.

b1-rakosikorszak-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Rákosi's Cult
b1-rakosikorszak-02.scenario: Your Hungarian teacher is going through the citizenship topics with you. She asks what happened in 1949 and how the propaganda named Rákosi.
b1-rakosikorszak-02.prompt: Tell your teacher what came into being in 1949 and how the propaganda named Rákosi.
cues: Say what came into being in 1949
Say what the propaganda called Rákosi
b1-rakosikorszak-02.target: A sztálini alkotmány 1949-ben jött létre. A propaganda Rákosit Sztálin legjobb magyar tanítványának nevezte.
b1-rakosikorszak-02.english: The Stalinist constitution came into being in 1949. The propaganda called Rákosi Stalin's best Hungarian disciple.
b1-rakosikorszak-02.canDo: I can describe the one-party state and the cult of Mátyás Rákosi after 1949.

b1-rakosikorszak-03.title: Communicative Challenge: The Black Cars
b1-rakosikorszak-03.scenario: On a museum visit at Andrássy út 60 in Budapest, the guide asks you where the ÁVH worked and why people dreaded the black cars.
b1-rakosikorszak-03.prompt: Tell the guide where the ÁVH worked and why people dreaded the black cars.
cues: Say where the ÁVH worked
Say why people dreaded the black cars
b1-rakosikorszak-03.target: Az ÁVH az Andrássy út 60-ban működött. Az emberek rettegtek a fekete autóktól, mert az ÁVH éjjel ezekkel hurcolta el az embereket.
b1-rakosikorszak-03.english: The ÁVH worked at Andrássy út 60. People dreaded the black cars because the ÁVH dragged people away in them at night.
b1-rakosikorszak-03.canDo: I can say what the ÁVH and Andrássy út 60 were.

b1-rakosikorszak-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Two Show Trials
b1-rakosikorszak-04.scenario: Your teacher asks you, as practice for the citizenship interview, what happened to Rajk and to Mindszenty in the show trials.
b1-rakosikorszak-04.prompt: Tell your teacher what the court did to Rajk and to Mindszenty.
cues: Say what the court did to Rajk
Say what the court did to Mindszenty
b1-rakosikorszak-04.target: Rajk Lászlót 1949-ben koholt vádak alapján ítélték halálra. Mindszenty József bíborost életfogytiglani börtönre ítélték.
b1-rakosikorszak-04.english: László Rajk was sentenced to death in 1949 on fabricated charges. Cardinal József Mindszenty was sentenced to life imprisonment.
b1-rakosikorszak-04.canDo: I can say what a show trial was and who Rajk and Mindszenty were.

b1-rakosikorszak-05.title: Communicative Challenge: The Attic Sweeping
b1-rakosikorszak-05.scenario: At a museum exhibition about the 1950s, the guide asks you what the regime did to the wealthier farmers and what Sztálinváros was.
b1-rakosikorszak-05.prompt: Tell the guide how the regime treated the wealthier farmers and what Sztálinváros was.
cues: Say what the regime called the wealthier farmers
Say what Sztálinváros was
b1-rakosikorszak-05.target: A hatalom a módosabb gazdákat kulákoknak bélyegezte. Sztálinváros új szocialista város volt a puszta közepén.
b1-rakosikorszak-05.english: The regime branded the wealthier farmers kulaks. Sztálinváros was a new socialist town in the middle of the plain.
b1-rakosikorszak-05.canDo: I can say how the state treated the peasants in the early 1950s.

b1-rakosikorszak-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: The Rákosi Era in Review
b1-rakosikorszak-consolidation.scenario: At the end of the unit your teacher asks for a short summary of the Rákosi era for the citizenship interview.
b1-rakosikorszak-consolidation.prompt: Tell the teacher what the ÁVH did at night and what happened to Rajk.
cues: Say what the ÁVH did at night
Say what happened to Rajk
b1-rakosikorszak-consolidation.target: Az ÁVH éjjel hurcolta el az embereket. Rajk Lászlót koholt vádak alapján ítélték halálra.
b1-rakosikorszak-consolidation.english: The ÁVH dragged people away at night. László Rajk was sentenced to death on fabricated charges.
b1-rakosikorszak-consolidation.canDo: I can review the main events and people of the Rákosi era.

b1-otvenhat-01.title: Communicative Challenge: 23 October 1956
b1-otvenhat-01.scenario: You are preparing for your citizenship interview. The examiner asks what happened in Budapest on 23 October 1956 and what the students demanded.
b1-otvenhat-01.prompt: Tell the examiner when the student demonstration began and how the students summarised their demands.
cues: Say when the student demonstration began
Say how the students summarised their demands
b1-otvenhat-01.target: Az egyetemista tüntetés október 23-án délután kezdődött. A diákok tizenhat pontban foglalták össze a követeléseiket.
b1-otvenhat-01.english: The student demonstration began on the afternoon of 23 October. The students summarised their demands in sixteen points.
b1-otvenhat-01.canDo: I can say what happened in Budapest on 23 October 1956 and what the students demanded.

b1-otvenhat-02.title: Communicative Challenge: The Boys of Pest
b1-otvenhat-02.scenario: On a museum visit about 1956, the guide asks you who the pesti srácok were and what the Corvin köz was.
b1-otvenhat-02.prompt: Tell the guide how the boys of Pest fought and what the Corvin köz was.
cues: Say how the boys of Pest faced the Soviet tanks
Say what the Corvin köz was
b1-otvenhat-02.target: A pesti srácok Molotov-koktélokkal szálltak szembe a szovjet tankokkal. A Corvin köz a fegyveres ellenállás egyik központja volt.
b1-otvenhat-02.english: The boys of Pest faced the Soviet tanks with Molotov cocktails. The Corvin köz was one of the centres of the armed resistance.
b1-otvenhat-02.canDo: I can say who the pesti srácok were and how they fought the Soviet tanks.

b1-otvenhat-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Neutrality
b1-otvenhat-03.scenario: Your Hungarian teacher is going through the citizenship topics with you. She asks what Imre Nagy's government announced on 1 November 1956.
b1-otvenhat-03.prompt: Tell your teacher what Imre Nagy's government proclaimed and what it renounced on 1 November 1956.
cues: Say what the government proclaimed
Say which treaty the government renounced
b1-otvenhat-03.target: Nagy Imre kormánya 1956. november 1-jén kikiáltotta Magyarország semlegességét. A kormány felmondta a Varsói Szerződést.
b1-otvenhat-03.english: On 1 November 1956 Imre Nagy's government proclaimed Hungary's neutrality. The government renounced the Warsaw Pact.
b1-otvenhat-03.canDo: I can say what Imre Nagy's government announced on 1 November 1956.

b1-otvenhat-04.title: Communicative Challenge: 4 November
b1-otvenhat-04.scenario: At your citizenship interview the examiner asks when the Soviet attack on Budapest began and how it began.
b1-otvenhat-04.prompt: Tell the examiner when the Soviet invasion began and how.
cues: Say when the Soviet invasion began
Say how the Soviet army attacked
b1-otvenhat-04.target: A szovjet invázió 1956. november 4-én hajnalban kezdődött. A szovjet hadsereg hadüzenet nélkül támadta meg Budapestet.
b1-otvenhat-04.english: The Soviet invasion began at dawn on 4 November 1956. The Soviet army attacked Budapest without a declaration of war.
b1-otvenhat-04.canDo: I can say what happened on 4 November 1956.

b1-otvenhat-05.title: Communicative Challenge: After the Revolution
b1-otvenhat-05.scenario: On a museum visit the guide asks you what happened to Imre Nagy in 1958 and what happened at Heroes' Square in 1989.
b1-otvenhat-05.prompt: Tell the guide what happened to Imre Nagy in 1958 and in 1989.
cues: Say what happened to Imre Nagy in 1958
Say what happened at Heroes' Square in 1989
b1-otvenhat-05.target: Nagy Imrét 1958-ban kivégezték. 1989. június 16-án újratemették a Hősök terén.
b1-otvenhat-05.english: Imre Nagy was executed in 1958. On 16 June 1989 he was reburied at Heroes' Square.
b1-otvenhat-05.canDo: I can say what happened to the revolutionaries after 1956.

b1-otvenhat-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: 1956 in Review
b1-otvenhat-consolidation.scenario: At the end of the unit your teacher asks for a short summary of 1956 for the citizenship interview.
b1-otvenhat-consolidation.prompt: Tell the teacher when the revolution began and what the Soviet army did on 4 November.
cues: Say when the revolution began
Say what the Soviet army did on 4 November
b1-otvenhat-consolidation.target: A forradalom 1956. október 23-án kezdődött. November 4-én a szovjet hadsereg megtámadta Budapestet.
b1-otvenhat-consolidation.english: The revolution began on 23 October 1956. On 4 November the Soviet army attacked Budapest.
b1-otvenhat-consolidation.canDo: I can review the main events of the 1956 revolution.

b1-kadarkorszak-01.title: Communicative Challenge: The Kádár Compromise
b1-kadarkorszak-01.scenario: At your naturalization interview, the official asks you what Kádár's 1961 slogan meant.
b1-kadarkorszak-01.prompt: Tell the official what the slogan 'Aki nincs ellenünk, az velünk van' meant for people who did not rebel.
cues: Say what the slogan promised
Say that people were left alone
b1-kadarkorszak-01.target: Aki nem lázadt nyíltan, azt a hatalom békén hagyta. Ezt jelentette Kádár János jelszava.
b1-kadarkorszak-01.english: Whoever did not rebel openly was left alone by the authorities. That is what János Kádár's slogan meant.
b1-kadarkorszak-01.canDo: I can explain what Kádár's 1961 slogan 'Aki nincs ellenünk, az velünk van' meant.

b1-kadarkorszak-02.title: Communicative Challenge: The New Economic Mechanism
b1-kadarkorszak-02.scenario: At your naturalization interview, the official asks you about the economic reform of 1968.
b1-kadarkorszak-02.prompt: Tell the official when the New Economic Mechanism began and what the enterprises could do after it.
cues: Say when it began
Say what the enterprises could decide
b1-kadarkorszak-02.target: Az Új Gazdasági Mechanizmus 1968-ban indult el. A vállalatok a reform után önállóan dönthettek a termelésről.
b1-kadarkorszak-02.english: The New Economic Mechanism began in 1968. After the reform, enterprises could decide on production independently.
b1-kadarkorszak-02.canDo: I can say when the New Economic Mechanism began and what it changed.

b1-kadarkorszak-03.title: Communicative Challenge: The Happiest Barrack
b1-kadarkorszak-03.scenario: At your naturalization interview, the official asks why Hungary was called the happiest barrack.
b1-kadarkorszak-03.prompt: Tell the official why Hungary was called the happiest barrack and give one example from everyday life.
cues: Say why the nickname was used
Give one example of how families spent the summer
b1-kadarkorszak-03.target: Magyarországot a legvidámabb barakknak hívták, mert a többi szocialista országnál jobb volt az ellátás. Sok család a Balatonra utazott nyaralni.
b1-kadarkorszak-03.english: Hungary was called the happiest barrack because the supply was better than in the other socialist countries. Many families travelled to Lake Balaton for a holiday.
b1-kadarkorszak-03.canDo: I can explain why Hungary was called the happiest barrack and what goulash communism meant.

b1-kadarkorszak-04.title: Communicative Challenge: The Three Ts
b1-kadarkorszak-04.scenario: You are visiting a museum in Budapest, and the guide asks what you know about culture under Kádár.
b1-kadarkorszak-04.prompt: Tell the guide what the three Ts were and what the Beszélő was.
cues: Name the three groups of works
Say what the Beszélő was
b1-kadarkorszak-04.target: A három T a támogatott, a tűrt és a tiltott művek csoportja. A Beszélő a demokratikus ellenzék szamizdat folyóirata volt.
b1-kadarkorszak-04.english: The three Ts were the groups of supported, tolerated and banned works. The Beszélő was the samizdat journal of the democratic opposition.
b1-kadarkorszak-04.canDo: I can explain the three Ts: támogatott, tűrt and tiltott.

b1-kadarkorszak-05.title: Communicative Challenge: The Debt Years
b1-kadarkorszak-05.scenario: At your naturalization interview, the official asks what happened to the economy in the 1980s.
b1-kadarkorszak-05.prompt: Tell the official what happened to the debt and to living standards, and when Hungary joined the IMF.
cues: Say what happened to the debt
Say what happened to living standards
Say when Hungary joined the IMF
b1-kadarkorszak-05.target: Az államadósság egyre nagyobb lett, az életszínvonal pedig romlani kezdett. Magyarország 1982-ben belépett a Nemzetközi Valutaalapba.
b1-kadarkorszak-05.english: The state debt grew bigger and bigger, and living standards began to get worse. Hungary joined the International Monetary Fund in 1982.
b1-kadarkorszak-05.canDo: I can explain why Hungary's debt grew in the 1980s and what happened to living standards.

b1-kadarkorszak-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: The Kádár Era in Brief
b1-kadarkorszak-consolidation.scenario: At your naturalization interview, the official asks you to sum up the Kádár era in two sentences.
b1-kadarkorszak-consolidation.prompt: Tell the official when the reform began and when Kádár was replaced and from which post.
cues: Say when the New Economic Mechanism began
Say when and from which post Kádár was replaced
b1-kadarkorszak-consolidation.target: Az Új Gazdasági Mechanizmus 1968-ban indult el. Kádár Jánost 1988 májusában leváltották a főtitkári posztról.
b1-kadarkorszak-consolidation.english: The New Economic Mechanism began in 1968. János Kádár was replaced as general secretary in May 1988.
b1-kadarkorszak-consolidation.canDo: I can summarise the Kádár era: the compromise, the 1968 reform, the goulash years, the opposition and the debt crisis.

b1-rendszervaltas-01.title: Communicative Challenge: The Roundtable Talks
b1-rendszervaltas-01.scenario: At your naturalization interview, the official asks you what the National Roundtable talks of 1989 were.
b1-rendszervaltas-01.prompt: Tell the official who sat down at the National Roundtable and what the sides agreed about the transition.
cues: Say who sat down at one table
Say what the sides agreed about the transition
b1-rendszervaltas-01.target: A Nemzeti Kerekasztalnál az állampárt és az ellenzék képviselői ültek egy asztalhoz. A felek megállapodtak, hogy az átmenet békés legyen.
b1-rendszervaltas-01.english: At the National Roundtable, representatives of the ruling party and the opposition sat down at one table. The parties agreed that the transition should be peaceful.
b1-rendszervaltas-01.canDo: I can say what the Opposition Roundtable and the National Roundtable were.

b1-rendszervaltas-02.title: Communicative Challenge: The Open Border
b1-rendszervaltas-02.scenario: At your naturalization interview, the official asks you about the opening of the border in 1989.
b1-rendszervaltas-02.prompt: Tell the official when the Pan-European Picnic was and when Hungary announced the border opening.
cues: Say when the picnic was
Say when the border opening was announced
b1-rendszervaltas-02.target: A Páneurópai piknik 1989. augusztus 19-én volt. Szeptember 10-én a kormány bejelentette a határnyitást.
b1-rendszervaltas-02.english: The Pan-European Picnic was on 19 August 1989. On 10 September the government announced the border opening.
b1-rendszervaltas-02.canDo: I can explain what happened on the Austrian border in spring and summer 1989.

b1-rendszervaltas-03.title: Communicative Challenge: The Reburial
b1-rendszervaltas-03.scenario: You are standing on Heroes' Square in Budapest with a guide who asks what happened there in 1989.
b1-rendszervaltas-03.prompt: Tell the guide when Imre Nagy was reburied and how many coffins stood on the steps.
cues: Say when the reburial was
Say how many coffins there were
b1-rendszervaltas-03.target: Nagy Imre újratemetése 1989. június 16-án volt. Hat koporsó állt a Műcsarnok lépcsőin.
b1-rendszervaltas-03.english: The reburial of Imre Nagy was on 16 June 1989. Six coffins stood on the steps of the Műcsarnok.
b1-rendszervaltas-03.canDo: I can say when Imre Nagy was reburied and how many coffins stood on the steps.

b1-rendszervaltas-04.title: Communicative Challenge: The Republic Is Proclaimed
b1-rendszervaltas-04.scenario: At your naturalization interview, the official asks when and by whom the Republic was proclaimed.
b1-rendszervaltas-04.prompt: Tell the official who proclaimed the Republic and on what date.
cues: Say who proclaimed it
Say the date
b1-rendszervaltas-04.target: Szűrös Mátyás 1989. október 23-án kikiáltotta a Magyar Köztársaságot.
b1-rendszervaltas-04.english: Mátyás Szűrös proclaimed the Republic of Hungary on 23 October 1989.
b1-rendszervaltas-04.canDo: I can say when and by whom the Republic was proclaimed.

b1-rendszervaltas-05.title: Communicative Challenge: The First Free Elections
b1-rendszervaltas-05.scenario: At your naturalization interview, the official asks you about the elections of 1990.
b1-rendszervaltas-05.prompt: Tell the official when the first free elections were held and which party won the most seats.
cues: Say when the elections were held
Say which party won the most seats
b1-rendszervaltas-05.target: Az első szabad választásokat 1990 tavaszán tartották. Az MDF kapta a legtöbb mandátumot.
b1-rendszervaltas-05.english: The first free elections were held in the spring of 1990. The MDF got the most seats.
b1-rendszervaltas-05.canDo: I can say when the first free elections were held and which party won the most seats.

b1-rendszervaltas-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: The Change of Regime in Brief
b1-rendszervaltas-consolidation.scenario: At your naturalization interview, the official asks you to sum up the change of regime in two sentences.
b1-rendszervaltas-consolidation.prompt: Tell the official when the Republic was proclaimed and when the last Soviet soldier left Hungary.
cues: Say when the Republic was proclaimed
Say when the last Soviet soldier left
b1-rendszervaltas-consolidation.target: A Magyar Köztársaságot 1989. október 23-án kiáltották ki. Az utolsó szovjet katona 1991 júniusában elhagyta Magyarországot.
b1-rendszervaltas-consolidation.english: The Republic of Hungary was proclaimed on 23 October 1989. The last Soviet soldier left Hungary in June 1991.
b1-rendszervaltas-consolidation.canDo: I can summarise the change of regime: the Roundtable, the border opening, the reburial, the Republic and the elections.
